InvItemInstanceReservation.name: InvItemInstanceReservation
InvItemInstanceReservation.description: Represents the inventory reservation for a specific item instance for a given item reservation source.

InventoryItemReservationId.description: The item reservation associated with a specific unit.

InventoryBatchItemReservationId.description: The batch item reservation for a specific unit.

IsAutoReserved.description: Indicates whether the reservation was automatically generated or manually entered by a user.

ItemInstanceId.description: The item instance that represents the specific product being reserved.

ProductBatchItemId.description: The product batch Item associated with the serialized product.

ProductItemId.description: The product Item associated with the serialized product.

ReservationDateTime.description: The date and time when the inventory was reserved.

ReservationItemSourceId.description: The order line item for which the reservation is created.

Status.description: The status of the serialized product inventory reservation.
